name: Cleanup After Combined Wall+Ceiling Finish
intent: Single cleanup pass: remove trim masking, remove fixture protection (spray methods only), single subfloor vacuum, final inspect walls + final inspect ceiling. Replaces the duplicated floor-vacuum and fixture-removal that would fire if wall+ceiling finish scenarios ran separately.
doctrine: Merges the cleanup tasks from MOD_CLEANUP_WALL_FINISH and MOD_CLEANUP_CEILING_FINISH, dropping the wall's subfloor vacuum (TSK_VACUUM_SUBFLOOR_POST_WALL) since the ceiling vacuum sweeps the same floor once. Final inspects stay per-substrate for correct quantification. Fixture removal gates by method (spray methods only installed fixture protection).
